payload.reason: The evidence provides specific measures taken to ensure the accuracy of the confidence network, including the introduction of a learned confidence estimate and a confidence-based label smoothing technique.

claims.text: A learned confidence estimate is introduced to improve the accuracy of predictions in neural machine translation (NMT).
The confidence network uses a novel confidence-based label smoothing technique, where predictions with higher confidence receive less smoothing, enhancing calibration.
The confidence estimation is designed to work jointly with the training process of the NMT model, allowing for better adaptation to the task.
